claim: Construct actual integral noncontact four-root order, normalized dt frames including every prime localization, and literal integral quadratic tensors. No all-prime or complete-model identification claim.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The base is the literal polynomial localization and the cover is the original four-quadratic tensor construction, now over R. The modules are the actual relative Kahler module and its tensor square, not abstract scalar lines.
obligations.justification: The base is the literal polynomial localization and the cover is the original four-quadratic tensor construction, now over R. The modules are the actual relative Kahler module and its tensor square, not abstract scalar lines.

obligations.name: Index coverage
obligations.constructed_input: Every coefficient_unit theorem covers all i in Fin 4. All four factors occur in P. atPrimeFrame covers every actual prime of this same open order, without replacing the prime family by a cardinality statement.
obligations.justification: Every coefficient_unit theorem covers all i in Fin 4. All four factors occur in P. atPrimeFrame covers every actual prime of this same open order, without replacing the prime family by a cardinality statement.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: P is inverted, and the etale construction requires 2 and all twists to be units. Missing contact and bad-coefficient primes are not claimed covered. Existence of an integral complete-source model is not inferred.

The dt frame transports through these maps, and atPrimeFrame uses the actual localization at each prime. No additional field identification is asserted.

The polynomial frame, localization formal etaleness and etale frame transport then construct the frame. No derivation-preservation assumption is supplied.
